question: One Stop Centre scheme was launched on: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (21/03/2021) Shift 2)

question: What is the amount of annual health benefit cover to be provided per family under the 'Ayushman Bharat' scheme of the Government of India? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 1)

question: What is the name of the scheme which aims to provide LED bulbs to domestic consumers at subsidized rate? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: 'Roshan Scheme'
'Ujala Scheme'
'Har Ghar Bijli Scheme'
'Bulb Scheme'
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ujala Scheme

Explanation:
The Ujala Scheme (Unnat Jyoti by Affordable LEDs for All) is a flagship initiative by the Government of India aimed at providing LED bulbs to domestic consumers at subsidized rates. Implemented by the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), the scheme focuses on energy conservation and reduction of carbon emissions. Launched in 2015, it targets the distribution of 77 crore LED bulbs across the country through collaboration with DISCOMs and private companies. The scheme has significantly reduced electricity consumption and lowered electricity bills for households. It is a key part of India’s efforts to promote energy efficiency and combat climate change.

question: Sarva Siksha Abhiyan is a significant step towards providing elementary education to all the children in the age group of ______ years. (RRB NTPC CBT-I (05/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: 6-15
8-15
6-14
7-15
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 6-14

Explanation:
Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA) is a flagship program of the Government of India aimed at providing elementary education to all children in the age group of 6 to 14 years. Launched in 2001, it gained legal backing through the Right to Education Act (RTE Act, 2009). The program focuses on improving school infrastructure, teacher recruitment, and promoting girls' education. Its primary goal is to achieve Universal Elementary Education (UEE) by ensuring that every child in this age group has access to free and compulsory education. SSA has significantly contributed to increasing literacy rates and reducing gender disparities in education across India.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ In which year was Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan launched? → 2001
☛ What is the full form of SSA? → Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan
☛ When was the RTE Act enacted? → 2009

question: Which of the following rights does the MGNREGA Scheme guarantee? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (06/04/2021) Shift 2)

Right to speech
Right to information
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Right to work

Explanation:
MGNREGA (Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act) is a social security scheme that guarantees the Right to work to rural households. This act was passed in 2005 and its main objective is to ensure employment in rural areas. Under this scheme, adult members of each household are provided guaranteed employment for at least 100 days per financial year. The work is based on unskilled labor such as road construction or pond digging. The goal of MGNREGA is to reduce rural unemployment and provide livelihood security.

Explanation:

MGNREGA भारत सरकार की एक प्रमुख योजना है जिसका उद्देश्य ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में रहने वाले परिवारों को रोजगार प्रदान करना है। यह योजना जल संरक्षण, भूमि विकास, सिंचाई, ग्रामीण सड़कें और ग्रामीण बुनियादी ढाँचे से संबंधित कार्यों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करती है। इसके तहत प्रत्येक ग्रामीण परिवार को वित्तीय वर्ष में 100 दिन का रोजगार गारंटी दी जाती है। यह अधिनियम वर्ष 2005 में लागू हुआ और इसका उद्देश्य ग्रामीण आजीविका को सुरक्षित करना तथा प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का संरक्षण करना है। यह योजना श्रम-गहन कार्यों पर जोर देती है और महिलाओं की भागीदारी को बढ़ावा देती है।
